player_prompt.intro:
Uyiyithonde ndiyaphi na Player {player_id} kumdlalo we-Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; uyibona kuphela icadi lempikiswano.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) ngemdlalo, {max_rounds} mizamo yomdlalo.
- Izinto ezivumelekile: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ngumahluko omancipheka <= ichip count yakho.)
- Icadi elihle kude iphumelela ipoti kuliphi ukubonakala.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Nika ngaphezu kwe-BRAKITI eyodwa, njengoko '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', noma '[fold]'.
invalid_move.amount_min: Isixa sokubheja / sokudibanisa kufuneka sibe yi-≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Akukho nto yokutsalela umnxeba; unokwenza [check] endaweni yoko.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Sebenzisa [bet X] ukuvula; akukho kubhejo lokuwuphakamisa.

message.showdown_tie: Umdlalo wokugqibela ubhangile: bobabini {card}. Ipot split  ngamnye ufumana {split} .

outcome.draw: Iichips ezilinganayo emva kwazo zonke iirandi
